descriptionChirho: Totality or universality applied to a class or group, indicating every member or the entirety of something (Aramaic כֹּל in construct or absolute with various prepositions).
Indefinite or distributive use indicating any individual member of a class, often in conditional, negative, or generalizing contexts.
Substantive use in the determined state (emphatic) meaning 'everything, all things, the totality' as a self-standing noun rather than a modifier.
